About these 2 rides

They ride on Tuesdays and Saturdays. The earliest start is Mountain State Wheelers Saturday Ride at 9:00 am; the latest is MAMBA Weekly Group Ride at 6:30 pm. The group waits for everyone on 1 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 1. By bike: 1 mountain bike and 1 road. Both were checked at the source between Sep 15 and Oct 1, 2026.
